# Sutra UI

> Sutra UI (`@sutra/ui`) is a React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 component library built on Radix UI: primitives, patterns, domain kits and full-page blocks, with design tokens (light, dark and a paper style), right-to-left support and CSS-first motion that respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Install and set up:

```
pnpm add @sutra/ui
```

```css
/* your Tailwind v4 stylesheet */
@import "@sutra/ui/styles.css";
```

Imports: everything is a flat named export of the root (`import { Button } from "@sutra/ui"`); the same names come from subpaths by domain (`@sutra/ui/overlays`, `@sutra/ui/forms`, `@sutra/ui/dataviz`, `@sutra/ui/icons` for Remix icons). Optional peers load only from their own subpaths (`@sutra/ui/editor`, `@sutra/ui/terminal`, `@sutra/ui/pdf`).

Rules every component follows (read `llms-full.txt` or the skill `skills/sutra-ui` for the full digest): colour comes from tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`), never palette classes or `dark:` overrides; semantic colour is `tone` (`neutral | primary | success | warning | destructive | info`), categorical colour is `accent`; loading is `loading`, empty is `emptyState`; layout uses logical utilities (`ms-`, `ps-`, `start-`) so RTL works; motion uses the `--sutra-*` tokens and stands still under reduced motion.

## Components

One markdown file per component (props, variants, notes, an example). Parts of a family (`DialogContent`) are linked from the family page.

### @sutra/ui/core

@sutra/ui/core: every primitive (src/primitives), the basic controls everything else builds on. GENERATED by scripts/gen-index.mjs from the folder structure. Do not edit; rerun `pnpm gen:index`.

- [Accordion](md/Accordion.md) (+3 parts): Vertically stacked set of collapsible sections.
- [AlertBanner](md/AlertBanner.md): Full-width announcement banner for the top of an app or page.
- [AppStoreBadge](md/AppStoreBadge.md): Official-style "Download on the App Store / Get it on Google Play" link badge.
- [AspectRatio](md/AspectRatio.md): Box that keeps a fixed width/height ratio for media and embeds.
- [Avatar](md/Avatar.md) (+4 parts): User avatar with image, initials fallback, status dot and verified badge.
- [AvatarGroup](md/AvatarGroup.md): Overlapping stack of avatars with overflow count and optional add button.
- [Badge](md/Badge.md): Compact label for status, category or count.
- [Button](md/Button.md): The standard button. Extra props are spread to the `<button>` (or to the child…
- [ButtonGroup](md/ButtonGroup.md) (+2 parts): Attached row (or column) of buttons. Pass `type="single" | "multiple"` to turn…
- [Card](md/Card.md) (+6 parts): Card surface used across components and blocks; compose it with `CardHeader`,…
- [Chip](md/Chip.md) (+1 parts): Interactive pill: toggleable filter, removable tag or selectable option.
- [CloseButton](md/CloseButton.md): Icon-only "X" button for dismissing dialogs, alerts and toasts, and…
- [Collapse](md/Collapse.md): Height-auto open and close for a section, filter row or wizard step.
- [Collapsible](md/Collapsible.md) (+2 parts): Show/hide section with an animated height: `Collapsible`, `CollapsibleTrigger`,…
- [Container](md/Container.md): Centres content and caps its width (`size`), with responsive horizontal…
- [ContentDivider](md/ContentDivider.md): Alias of `Separator`.
- [CopyButton](md/CopyButton.md): Copies a value to the clipboard, swaps to a check mark and announces "Copied to…
- [CopyField](md/CopyField.md): Read-only value with a copy button, for commands, ids, keys and URLs.
- [DataTable](md/DataTable.md): Data-driven table with sorting, selection, loading and empty states.
- [DirectionProvider](md/DirectionProvider.md): Tells Sutra and its Radix primitives which way the text runs. Put one at the…
- [Eyebrow](md/Eyebrow.md): Small all-caps label above headings.
- [FloatingActionButton](md/FloatingActionButton.md): Floating primary action, optionally expanding into a speed-dial menu.
- [Frame](md/Frame.md) (+6 parts): A titled tray around a panel of rows: `FrameHeader` (title, description,…
- [GlyphSpinner](md/GlyphSpinner.md): Text-glyph spinner (braille dots, arcs, …): a preset of `<Spinner…
- [Grid](md/Grid.md) (+1 parts): 12-column responsive grid (4 → 8 → 12 columns). Use `GridItem span` to size…
- [Heading](md/Heading.md): Heading with the display type scale (`size`); the element level (`as`) is…
- [HStack](md/HStack.md): Horizontal `Stack` (`direction="row"`). Takes the other `Stack` props.
- [InlineAlert](md/InlineAlert.md) (+3 parts): Contextual message placed inline with content (forms, panels, settings).
- [InlineCode](md/InlineCode.md): Inline code.
- [Item](md/Item.md) (+7 parts): One row: `ItemMedia`, `ItemContent` (`ItemTitle` and `ItemDescription`) and…
- [Kbd](md/Kbd.md): Keyboard key hint.
- [MeshGradient](md/MeshGradient.md): Decorative animated gradient background; children render above it.
- [Progress](md/Progress.md) (+3 parts): Linear progress bar, determinate or indeterminate (role="progressbar"): how far…
- [ScrollArea](md/ScrollArea.md): Custom-styled scroll container with thin overlay scrollbars and optional edge…
- [ScrollBar](md/ScrollBar.md): Thin scrollbar track + thumb; rendered automatically by `ScrollArea`.
- [Separator](md/Separator.md): Horizontal or vertical rule, optionally with a centered label.
- [Skeleton](md/Skeleton.md): Loading placeholder with a shimmer.
- [SlideToConfirm](md/SlideToConfirm.md): Confirm an irreversible action by sliding the thumb along the track.
- [Snackbar](md/Snackbar.md): Compact dark (inverse) notification bar with an optional action, Material-style.
- [SocialButton](md/SocialButton.md): OAuth sign-in button with the provider's logo. Defaults to "Continue with…
- [Spinner](md/Spinner.md): Loading indicator. Uses `currentColor`, so set a text color to recolor it.
- [SplitButton](md/SplitButton.md): A primary action fused with a chevron that opens a menu of secondary actions.
- [Stack](md/Stack.md): Flex stack on the 4px spacing grid.
- [StatusBadge](md/StatusBadge.md): Status pill with a colored dot (or a spinner / icon).
- [StatusDot](md/StatusDot.md): Small colored dot (or round status glyph) indicating a status.
- [StepIndicator](md/StepIndicator.md): Alias of `Steps`.
- [Steps](md/Steps.md): Progress through a multi-step flow.
- [TabDropdown](md/TabDropdown.md): A tab bar that collapses tabs which don't fit into a "More" dropdown…
- [Table](md/Table.md) (+8 parts): Data table inside a bordered, scrollable box. The box takes focus while it…
- [Text](md/Text.md): Body text with `size`, `tone` and `weight`; renders a `<p>` unless `as` says…
- [TextLink](md/TextLink.md): Inline text link with underline styles and optional external indicator.
- [Toaster](md/Toaster.md): Sonner toaster styled with Sutra tokens. Follows the `.dark` class on <html>…
- [ToggleButton](md/ToggleButton.md): A button that stays pressed (`aria-pressed`): bold, mute, pin.
- [ToggleGroup](md/ToggleGroup.md) (+1 parts): Row of toggle buttons, `type="single"` or `"multiple"`, with roving focus (one…
- [UndoAction](md/UndoAction.md): A destructive button that turns into a counted "Undo" for N seconds and only…
